verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com, the documentation domain that hosts Atlas docs. Atlas pages are also served as agent-friendly markdown (atlas.md, atlas/signup.md), so an agent can be pointed at clean, machine-readable Atlas documentation. missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt actually indexes Atlas-specific pages (it is Stripe-wide), Atlas-specific agent guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
